rubric.factAuthority: Chronological user statements and latest explicit corrections only. Actual earlier assistant replies may be wrong and are not evidence of user facts. Assistant identity Unidad is supplied by the saved system context.
rubric.failed: No usable current response, decisive fact/referent is contradicted, roles are lost, or the output is materially incoherent. A correct fragment does not compensate for a wrong decisive name/title/alias.
rubric.full_semantically_met: Responds to the current request with understandable minimally natural Spanish, preserves decisive facts and roles, and follows current intent. Synonyms, short acknowledgements and reasonable clarification questions need not match the reference wording.
rubric.grammar: Minor understandable colloquial preposition omissions do not invalidate an otherwise correct response; fragments and incoherent complements do.
rubric.issuesAreDescriptive: Issue labels describe observed output errors. They do not establish positional attention, learning or other causal mechanisms.
rubric.partial: An identifiable correct or relevant component remains, but the current request is incomplete or discourse/grammar is degraded. Partial is not counted as complete.
rubric.references: Every offline reference was checked against the user episode; references guide the requested scope but are not the sole allowed answer.

scope.selection: All saved replies; one source-validation episode per template selected by hash in the frozen cases.

limitations: These are iteratively inspected development examples, not an unseen final-test result or a demonstration of general conversation.
All saved conversational examples are authored fictional scenarios; no creator chat history was exported as training or evidence.
The first cold hello succeeds in the saved free dialogue, but assistant identity after a greeting and new user names fail.
Fact copying, latest corrections and listening versus acting remain unreliable; incoherent and repetitive outputs are retained transparently.
The semantic review was done by an unblinded project assistant with references visible, not independently rated by a human panel.
Four inference artifact files are portable; exact training resume still requires the private corpus and optimizer/checkpoint state.
Original evidence file hashes are included. Workspace path strings are made relative; user messages, model texts and token IDs are not edited.
